work_handoff.title: BLACK_LADY_GENERIC_GUEST_CROWD_CORE_SET_V001｜LEFT PROFILE Candidate 01
requirements: This formal Bundle spec authorizes controlled-reference validation only while build_authorized=false. It does NOT authorize formal Bundle Build or Work image generation.
The delivered visual authority, when formal build is separately authorized, is the single approved FRONT Authority PNG only.
These are not ten new people. They are the exact same Guest A-J identities already approved in the FRONT Authority, now viewed from a true 90-degree LEFT PROFILE.
Target canvas = 1536x1024 landscape / 2 rows x 5 columns.
Fixed slots: top row Guest A/B/C/D/E; bottom row Guest F/G/H/I/J.
Guest A-F are female; Guest G-J are male.
LEFT PROFILE means face and nose toward screen-left. Avoid front, 3/4-front and 3/4-back interpretations.
All ten are full-body natural upright static views with complete head and feet, relaxed arms and hands out of pockets.
Preserve identity, apparent age, hairstyle, body build, relative height, wardrobe identity, footwear and identity-defining visible markings from the approved FRONT Authority.
For side-view geometry not actually visible in FRONT, use minimum-new-information interpretation; do not invent distinctive new identity traits.
Guest I must remain male, muscular, short stiff/brush-cut hairstyle identity, black sleeveless top, with approved tattoos/body markings preserved where physically visible from the left-side angle.
Preserve ten-person identity separation; do not solve the side view by giving multiple Guests the same profile-face template.
Use the FRONT Authority's established visual language; do not reintroduce named-character style-parent identity.
Background must remain simple, neutral and low-distraction. This is a controlled identity reference board, not a Story Shot.
No model-generated letters, names or text labels.
No backpack, shoulder bag, crossbody bag, handbag, luggage, suspicious bag straps, handheld props or story-scene objects.
Generate exactly one LEFT PROFILE PNG only after separate Product Owner generation authorization, then stop for review.
Do not generate RIGHT PROFILE, BACK, N21 or N23 in this pass.
exclusions: backpacks or bags of any kind
